Renderings: the Middle Assyrian Laws, Tablet B (MAL B), project 7 of חוקים-ובריתות/

Contents
  • 1. Formulas and recurring words taken from MAL A, LH and the corpus
  • 2. MAL B words fixed by T9

Binding above this file: the corpus ../renderings.md (§0, §5, §6.1–§6.2 and the "Merged from …" notes), MAL A's ../4-החוקים-האשוריים-התיכונים-A/renderings.md (the same dialect and the same legal formulas: identical Middle Assyrian gets identical Hebrew), the Laws of Hammurabi's fixed formulas and words (../2-חוקי-חמורבי/renderings.md §1 F1–F43, §2, §4) and the Laws of Eshnunna's decisions. ../laws_verify.py MALB checks the shared formulas and compares every identical normalization with MAL A, LH and LE. Fixed by T9 (run 6, 2026-10-18). Plain plene Hebrew as it must appear in the > lines; vocalized forms strip to it.

Columns: Akkadian (ORACC norm; CDA lemma) | Hebrew | rejected | echo | lines.
